Title: Power BI Embedded supports row-level security for tiles and dashboards

Body.Content:
Power BI Embedded now supports row-level security (RLS) for embedding tiles and dashboards.

The implementation is similar to report RLS and is done through embedToken. The API accepts both multiple datasets and multiple identities to support dashboards containing multiple tiles that are connected to different reports.

To learn more, see the Power BI blog.
